answer: In this PoA network, reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, verifiable honest service to retain influence. A freshly spawned sybil has almost no trusted incoming weight and therefore near-zero EigenTrust eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot manufacture trust without credible peers. Like a sparrow in a nebula guarding a pearl, it gains no consensus power merely by appearing: it must earn durable endorsements over time.
